scripts.title: vesper hub beta
scripts.script:
⚠️ BETA TEST — ACCESS VIA DISCORD
This is a closed beta. To use the script and get the loadstring, you need to:
👉 Join: https://discord.gg/zC4aVyvwX
Once you're in:
- #demo — grab the loadstring and test it in-game
- #bug-reports — report bugs AND suggest improvements (use the same channel for both for now)
Please test every toggle you can and post what broke / what you'd want added. This is actively being worked on.
scripts.features:
✨ Features (the full list)
Survivor
- Auto-complete minigames
- Auto safe exit (teleports to furthest exit at 0 computers)
- Auto self-escape pod
- Sprint (22 walk speed, no stamina loss)
- Walk Speed / Jump Power sliders (clamped to Roblox defaults)
- No-clip (door squeeze)
- Unlock camera
- Interaction bypass
- Hide Near Beast / Invisible Whole Round
- Full Bright / Fog Remover
Beast
- Auto hammer hit / auto tie-up
- Auto rescue (pull from nearby pods)
- TP → Nearest Survivor
- Dump Beast Stats (debug)
- Wall hop viewer
- Remove Beast Sound & Glow
- No jump slowdown / no hit slowdown
ESP
- Player ESP (fill, outline, 2D box, tracer, name, distance, skeleton)
- Beast POV camera — see the world from the beast's perspective, auto-spots you with a "⚠ YOU" pulse when the beast looks your way
- Object ESP (hackable computers, exit doors, freeze pods)
- Best computer ESP (gold highlight on the nearest hackable)
- Door ESP
- Locker ESP — highlights every HidingCloset so you can spot hiding spots
- Computer TP buttons (clickable overlay to teleport to hackable computers)
Radar
- Beast radar warning (red bar when beast is near)
- Beast ETA radar (time-to-reach in seconds)
- Auto-notify on beast power change
Server
- Server hop button
- Anti-cheat bypass (auto-runs on load)
- Panic button (Delete key disables everything instantly)
